the high cutting speed will give a best parameter in machining process of the AlSi/Aln MMCs material.
the high cutting speed will give better result in tool life.
the cutting tool with TiB2 coated is suitable to use in milling process of AlSi-AlN MMCs material and the high cutting speed is suitable in machining AlSi-AlN metal matrix composite.

the tool wear of metal matrix composite milling process using TiB2 coated cutting tool.
the tool wear when machining of AlSi/ AlN MMCs.
the development of an efficient tool wear prediction system for AlSi/Al N MMCs material.

the TiB2 coated insert is suitable to be used in the milling of AlSi/ AlN Metal Matrix Composite material.
the TiB2 coated cutting tool is a good choice to use in machining of MMC materials.
the cutting speed of 370m/min is recommended as an optimum cutting condition for longer tool wear life span in machining AlSi/AlNNMCs material.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed a new generation of metal matrix composite material which can be machined using TiB2 coated tools and this material can be used in automotive and aerospace sectors.

the use of a TiB2 coated tool is a viable option for machining AlSi/Aln MMCs.
